text: Demand gate completed as no-go. Audited repository API/docs, active and historical Mote beads, the Mote public discussion board, and all GitHub issues; found no concrete consumer request for sumFast, reassociation, or nondeterministic reduction semantics. Focused residual cost is documented: side-1024 contiguous Float.sum is 0.854x NumPy on JDK21 and 0.819x on JDK25, while exact-schedule ILP already provides 1.52-1.59x over the raw serial control and independent-lane vector work remains a possible exact path. No API or source change was made. The fixed 128-value block-pairwise default remains unchanged. Reopen only for a named workload that explicitly accepts specified NaN, signed-zero, overflow, determinism, and cross-platform semantics and demonstrates a material parity-gated benefit.
